preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
preconditions.description: The first line of input contains a single integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines[i+1]) > 0 and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in lines[i+1]) for i in range(1, len(lines))) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) and len(lines) > 1 else True
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a non-empty string s consisting only of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: int(lines[0]) == len(lines) - 1 if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else True
preconditions.description: The number of test case lines matches the integer T.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == int(lines[0]) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else True
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((out_line.strip() == '-1') or (len(out_line.strip().split()) == len(s) and set(map(int, out_line.strip().split())) == set(range(1, len(s) + 1))) for out_line, s in zip(out_lines, s_list)) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) and (out_lines := stdout.strip().splitlines()) and (s_list := [lines[i+1] for i in range(int(lines[0]))]) else True
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a permutation of 1 to n (where n is the length of s).

postconditions.expression: all((out_line.strip() == '-1' and not is_palindrome_permutable(s)) or (out_line.strip() != '-1' and is_palindrome_permutable(s)) for out_line, s in zip(out_lines, s_list)) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) and (out_lines := stdout.strip().splitlines()) and (s_list := [lines[i+1] for i in range(int(lines[0]))]) else True
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if and only if no permutation of s can form a palindrome; otherwise, a valid permutation is provided.

postconditions.expression: all((out_line.strip() == '-1') or (is_palindrome(''.join(s[p-1] for p in map(int, out_line.strip().split())))) for out_line, s in zip(out_lines, s_list)) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) and (out_lines := stdout.strip().splitlines()) and (s_list := [lines[i+1] for i in range(int(lines[0]))]) else True
postconditions.description: For every test case where a permutation is output, applying that permutation to s results in a string that is a palindrome.
